visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a modern kitchen with dark green cabinetry and bright recessed ceiling lights. A woman with short brown hair, wearing a light blue zip-up hoodie, holds a plastic-wrapped package. She uses yellow scissors to carefully cut the top off. (2) She reveals two dishwashing sponges shaped like a fried egg and a slice of toast with a yellow smiley face. She holds them up to her face, smiling broadly with wide eyes. The background shows a clean kitchen counter with a coffee machine. (3) Now wearing a checkered apron, she pumps clear liquid soap from a 'Goodies' brand bottle onto the egg-shaped sponge. She begins scrubbing a white ceramic bowl in a stainless steel sink filled with white soap suds. (4) She presents a bottle of 'Goodies' concentrated fruit and vegetable dish soap directly to the camera lens. The bottle is transparent with a white label and minimalist black text. She points at the label with her index finger as she speaks. (5) Returning to the sink, she demonstrates washing a large white pan. She rinses it under a silver faucet, showing the clean, non-greasy surface. Frequent on-screen graphics and variety-style text overlays appear to highlight product benefits. (6) The scene cuts to an array of cleaning products spread across a wooden table. She holds up two large tan '7 in 1' laundry detergent pod bags, showing the front packaging details clearly. (7) She reaches into one of the bags and pulls out a single, transparent, multi-chambered laundry pod, holding it between her thumb and forefinger for a close-up shot. She gestures towards her shoulder and neck area. (8) She picks up several clear spray bottles with black nozzles. She demonstrates them on various kitchen surfaces, including a black range hood, a silver refrigerator door, and a black air fryer, spraying and then wiping with a cloth. (9) In a bathroom setting, she sprays a clear liquid from a 'Goodies' bottle onto a chrome faucet and a white porcelain sink. She wipes the surface to demonstrate the removal of water spots and grime. (10) A screen recording of an Instagram mobile profile is shown. A red graphic hand points towards a link in the bio section. The video concludes with the creator holding a product and smiling at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese. A light, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM with a moderate tempo begins. The sharp, rhythmic sound of plastic packaging being cut by scissors is clearly heard. (2) The voice continues with an expressive, animated tone. A distinct 'pop' sound effect is heard as she presents the sponges. The BGM maintains a steady, cheerful rhythm with soft piano chords joining the mix. (3) The mechanical clicking of a soap pump is heard three times. This is followed by the splashing of water and the squelching sound of a wet sponge being squeezed. Cartoonish laughter sound effects are added to the track. (4) A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs. The speaker's voice becomes slightly more narrative and informative as she describes the dish soap's specific ingredients. The BGM remains in the background at a lower volume level. (5) Metallic clinking sounds are heard as ceramic dishes are moved in a kitchen sink. The sound of running water from a faucet provides a consistent ambient noise floor. The speaker's voice rises in pitch to indicate excitement. (6) A melodic chime sound effect signals a transition. The voice shifts to discussing laundry detergent pods. The crinkling sound of a large plastic bag being opened and hands rustling through pods is prominent. (7) A sharp 'ding' sound effect occurs as she holds up a pod. The speaker's articulation is very clear. The background music continues with a simple, repetitive electronic keyboard melody that complements the guitar. (8) The rhythmic 'psst-psst' sound of a spray bottle being used is repeated several times. Each spray is followed by a soft wiping sound. A 'magic sparkle' chime SFX is played to emphasize cleanliness and effectiveness. (9) The audio concludes with a final call to action. The BGM volume swells slightly before a quick fade-out. The speaker's voice maintains high arousal and a positive, joyful valence until the end of the video.
